## Description

Provide a clear and concise summary of the changes made and which issue it addresses (if any).

Fixes #(issue)

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Code cleanup / refactoring

## Checklist

- [ ] My code follows the style guidelines of this project
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my own code
- [ ] I have commented my code where necessary, particularly in hard-to-understand areas
- [ ] I have verified that `npm run test:backend` passes with zero errors
- [ ] I have verified that `npm run build:frontend` builds without errors
- [ ] My changes generate no new warnings or unhandled exceptions
- [ ] No private secrets, API keys, or sensitive credentials are included
